description: arXiv:2608.00946v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Existing 6-DoF grasp detectors typically rank grasp candidates by detector confidence. However, our analysis on GraspNet-1Billion shows that detector confidence is often poorly aligned with grasp quality, leaving successful grasp candidates at low ranks.
